reconciliation.correction: The first campaign contains 689 completed LC0 EXPLORE CPU observations (not 692). Missing/incomplete evidence is explicitly excluded, not counted or imputed. The maximum and selected reservation remain unchanged.

selection_rationale.lc0_explore: Round the maximum retained LC0 EXPLORE CPU observation (1760 ms) upward to the next 100 ms boundary.
selection_rationale.lc0_verify: Cover both base VERIFY and same-process staged VERIFY extension; retained maximum is 1290 ms, rounded to 1300 ms plus 100 ms explicit headroom.
selection_rationale.stockfish_reckless: Retain the existing conservative 100 ms per-owner floor; no attempt is made here to lower their reservation from these failed lifecycle campaigns.
